cohort: 8821 women who had non-breech, singleton deliveries after 36 weeks of gestation, with no more than one previous cesarean section, at Oslo University Hospital, Ullevål from 2011-2012
finding: Maternal BMI ≥30 was an independent risk factor for delivery by emergency cesarean section for both primiparous and parous women.
mod_finding: Maternal BMI ≥30 was an independent risk factor for delivery by emergency cesarean section for both primiparous and parous women.
